summary: Bound QA precompile and the delivery DAG runtime evaluator to an explicit stable delivery_unit_ref. The existing QA compiler now validates and propagates the literal relation without inferring it; the QA contract requires new bound producer/QA STARTED and completion/RETURN owners to persist the same relation while preserving worker/generation/claim authority. The runtime canary now accepts durable STARTED+completion event pairs and fails closed on missing or mismatched relation. Deterministic CI proves 6000 ms overlap, 18000 ms serial baseline and 12000 ms critical path for a complete shared-unit fixture, while negative controls remain INSUFFICIENT_COMPARABLE_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE. Historical QA receipts were not rewritten, so the prior modeled 40% reduction remains simulation only.
